title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Robert Half are exclusively working with a long-established, family-focused business in the heart of the Cotswolds to recruit a Payroll Administrator. The company is growing and modernising, and it's investing in its people and services while staying true to its community values. You'll be the go-to person for accurate weekly payroll data. You'll also give the wider operations team practical administrative support, so this suits someone who likes variety and being close to the day-to-day.

Payroll Administrator
Salary: £35,000 per annum
Location: Bourton-on-the-Water, Cotswolds
Contract: Permanent, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

Key responsibilities
- Prepare and submit accurate weekly operational and payroll data for frontline colleagues
- Check clocking records against scheduled duties, investigating and resolving any discrepancies
- Manage holiday allocation for colleagues in line with business needs
- Act as a first point of contact for colleague queries by phone, email and in person
- Work closely with HR on colleague administration, including starters, leavers and employee updates
- Support day-to-day site operations, assisting the operations team when required
- Handle justified complaints through informal discussions
- Order and distribute uniform, and maintain the related records
- Manage petty cash, prepaid cards, cash machine issues and cash variances
- Keep accurate records, update internal systems and complete general administrative duties
- Support the wider team and promote company values at all times

About you
- Experience in payroll administration, including checking and correcting payroll data
- Experience working within a finance team
- Strong Excel skills and familiarity with rota systems
- Strong communication and teamwork skills, with excellent attention to detail
- Able to prioritise your workload, meet deadlines and work independently
- Reliable, punctual and flexible when the business needs it

What's on offer
- £35,000 per annum
- Holiday purchase scheme
- 20 days' annual leave plus bank holidays
- Pension scheme
- Lifestyle benefits
- Employee assistance programme
- Career development opportunities within the wider group

How to apply

Robert Half is working exclusively with the company on this role. To apply, please send your CV via the link or contact the Oxford office for a confidential conversation.

Robert Half Ltd acts as an employment business for temporary positions and an employment agency for permanent positions. Robert Half is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. Suitable candidates with equivalent qualifications and more or less experience can apply. Rates of pay and salary ranges are dependent upon your experience, qualifications and training. title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Our client, a group of market-leading brands deliver engineered water solutions such as pumps, booster sets, flow meter chambers and pressurisation units to customers across the UK and beyond. Based in Gloucester, they are now looking for a Salesforce Administrator to join their team.

As Salesforce Administrator you will be responsible for the day-to-day operation, configuration and ongoing development of the Group's Salesforce platform (Sales Cloud and Marketing Cloud) across their trading entities. Sitting within Group IT and reporting to the Head of IT, the role brings Salesforce capability in-house.

Please note- this role is based in Gloucester, with occasional travel to Henley, Colchester and Redditch

Key Responsibilities

Build, Automation & Development (Primary Focus)
- Design, build, test and maintain automation using Flow (record-triggered, screen, scheduled and autolaunched), validation rules, approval processes, and assignment and escalation rules.
- Configure and make targeted change amendments; commission bespoke development externally only where genuinely warranted.
- Investigate and resolve issues. Identifying root cause rather than symptom.

Platform Administration & Configuration
- Administer and configure Salesforce Sales Cloud and Marketing Cloud environments.
- Manage users, roles, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules and data access across clouds, applying least-privilege principles.
- Maintain reports, dashboards, list views and analytics used by commercial and marketing teams.

Release, Change & Environment Management
- Operate within Group IT change control: raise, document and obtain approval for changes in line with FWG IT policy, with defined rollback plans for higher-risk work.

Support & Incident Management
- Act as the escalation point for Salesforce incidents and service requests, working within Group IT service management processes and agreed response expectations.
- Triage, prioritise and resolve user issues, with clear criteria for the small number of cases that warrant escalation to Salesforce Support or an external partner.
- Maintain a prioritised backlog of enhancements and defects, visible to IT leadership and business stakeholders.
- Produce and maintain user guidance and deliver training to improve adoption and reduce avoidable demand.

Stakeholder, Vendor & People
- Work directly with commercial and marketing stakeholders across the Group's entities to gather requirements and translate them into scalable solutions - including the ability to challenge change that would damage the platform.

Administrative / Other
- Ensure Salesforce documentation, configuration records and process maps are maintained and accessible to relevant stakeholders.
- Any other duty that may reasonably be required by the Head of IT or IT Director.

Requirements
- Proven experience as a Salesforce Administrator.
- Strong working knowledge of Sales Cloud; hands-on experience of Marketing Cloud.
- Excellent communication skills and a business-focused mindset; able to work with non-technical stakeholders and technical IT colleagues alike.
- Comfortable operating as the in-house expert, working to IT governance, change control and documentation standards.
- Hands-on experience in a Salesforce greenfield implementation.
- Marketing Cloud Email Specialist, Administrator or Consultant certification.
- Experience of Salesforce integration with Sage 200 or EFACS, or comparable ERP integration.
- Familiarity with Pardot / Account Engagement, Tableau, CPQ or Salesforce-integrated applications.
- Experience in a multi-site or multi-entity business environment.
- Experience mentoring or supporting the development of a junior administrator.

Benefits

Monday- Friday 8am-5pm
Salary - £32,000

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Location: Cheltenham or Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire
Contract: Temporary, 2 to 3 months
Hours: Part-time, 21 hours over 3 days per week
Pay: £14.34 per hour (+ £1.73 holiday pay)
Start Date: ASAP

Prospectus is delighted to be supporting a leading national children's charity in the search for a temporary Administrative Assistant to join their Youth Support Service. Please note that due to the access to vulnerable young people and their data, this role is subject to a basic DBS check and five years' reference checks. This is a fully on-site position based at Tewkesbury Youth Hub.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and proactive administrator to support a busy frontline service that works with young people, families and partner organisations across the local community. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the service, providing high-quality administrative support and acting as a welcoming first point of contact for visitors and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
- Provide efficient and effective administrative support to Service Managers, Youth Workers and external partners.
- Act as the first point of contact at the Youth Hub, delivering a welcoming, professional and supportive experience.
- Manage incoming telephone, email and in-person enquiries.
- Coordinate meetings, diaries and service administration activities.
- Maintain accurate records, databases and electronic filing systems.
- Support the preparation and distribution of reports, meeting papers and correspondence.
- Assist with monitoring expenditure, processing invoices and financial administration.
- Order and manage office supplies and support the smooth operation of the hub.
- Ensure confidentiality and compliance when handling sensitive information.
- Provide general administrative support across the wider Youth Support Service.

Key Requirements:
- Recent, relevant experience in an administrative or office management position, ideally within a charitable or not-for-profit organisation, with knowledge of youth, family, or care services.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with confidence dealing with a wide range of different audiences and stakeholders, including the public.
- Proactive and adaptable approach with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Strong attention to detail and a completer-finisher mindset.
- Advanced IT skills including Outlook, Word and Excel, with experience using databases and reporting systems.
- Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately, with consideration of data privacy.

CVs will be reviewed on a rolling basis so if you're interested, please apply ASAP with your CV in Word format.

At Prospectus, we believe recruitment should be human-led and we are committed to supporting you throughout your application journey. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on age, gender, disability, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, or pregnancy/maternity. While AI may be used to support our administrative process, all applications are reviewed by people and all hiring decisions are made by experienced recruiters.
